correctness.rationale: For n>=4 the graph-distance cases show its only mutually maximally distant pairs are subdivider vertices indexed by disjoint K_n edges. The standard covering equivalence plus exact star/triangle classification proves the independent-family polynomial, strong dimension, inclusion-minimal sets and sharp batch-exchange threshold. Assumptions include all edges subdivided exactly once and complete geodesic distances.

value.rationale: Exact full enumerator and classification of inclusion-minimal landmark configurations for every n>=4 answer natural structural questions beyond the strong dimension. The exceptional connected Q3 unit-exchange at n=4 versus completely isolated minima for n>=5 and linear sharp threshold n-2 represent a concrete mathematical rigidity transition, not a numerical triviality. The proof and checks are self-contained with a motivated graph-operation domain.
